identity_impact: Research Memory policy, family, outcome, duplicate decision, bounded context, selected and excluded source references, deterministic reasons, ranking and sanitization versions, compatibility semantics, and every other meaning-bearing value receive canonical SHA-256 identities; Workspace timestamps and private paths are excluded.
evidence_level: Apex retrieval, duplicate, failure-memory, and bounded research-context facts only; no Candidate, package, budget, runner, lifecycle, single-run metric, formal evidence, qualification, or production truth is recreated.
fail_closed_behavior: Reject unbounded, unsafe, unavailable, dangling, mistyped, tampered, conflicting, or identity-drifting inputs; require canonical readback before every next step; duplicates stop before context, reservation, or launch; uncertain external state pauses with reconciliation_required and never repeats launch or run.
